tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Read an experiment's details without changing the page. Returns {slug, name, url, preview: {url, width, height}}. URLs are absolute and preview dimensions are pixels. Use open_experiment to navigate to the experiment.

tools.name: get_personal_info
tools.description: Read Sasi's personal information without changing the page. Returns {name, bio, url, email, profiles: [{label, handle, url}]}. Use toggle_about to change the visible About panel.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read a project's details without changing the page. Returns {name, description, year, url, screenshots: [{url, width, height}]}. Screenshot URLs are absolute and dimensions are pixels. Use toggle_project to change the visible panel.

tools.name: list_experiments
tools.description: Read Sasi's experiment catalog without changing the page. Returns {experiments: [{slug, name, url}]}; local URLs are relative to this origin. Use get_experiment for a preview, toggle_experiments to display the list, or open_experiment to navigate.

tools.name: list_other_experiments
tools.description: List images and demo videos of Sasi's other experiments from the feed, without changing the page. Returns {media: [{kind, url, width, height, poster?}]} in feed order; kind is image or video, url links directly to the media, URLs are absolute, dimensions are pixels, and poster is an optional video preview image URL. Use list_experiments for named interactive experiments, get_project for project screenshots, or toggle_experiments to display the feed.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Read Sasi's project catalog without changing the page. Returns {projects: [{name, description, year, url}]}. Use get_project for screenshots or toggle_project to change the visible panel.

tools.name: open_experiment
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the selected experiment, leaving the portfolio. Winder goes to an external website. Browser Back returns to the portfolio. Returns {navigatingTo: url} if delivered before navigation; the browser may return null after navigation. Use get_experiment to read details without navigating.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Sasi's projects, experiments, personal information, coding preferences at /agents.md and media collection without changing the page. Accepts names, paths, topics and common phrases such as show me animation demos, open-source projects, or how can I contact Sasi. Normalizes common aliases and removes conversational filler, then matches all remaining words; title matches rank first. Use all pages to list every indexed entry. Returns {results: [{kind, title, summary, url}]}; kind is project, experiment, personal_info or collection, URLs are absolute, and no matches returns an empty results array. Searches a curated catalog, not every file or the visual contents of unnamed media. Use get_project or get_experiment for details, get_personal_info for social links, or list_other_experiments for media links.

query.description: A name, path, topic or short phrase, such as show me animation demos. Use / for the homepage or all pages to browse the index.

tools.name: share_contact_email
tools.description: Share one email address with Sasi so he can get in touch. Fills the email field and waits for the visitor to press Send. After submission, returns {ok: true, message} on delivery or {ok: false, error} on failure.

tools.name: toggle_about
tools.description: Change the visible About Sasi panel. Closes it if already open; otherwise opens it and replaces any other panel. Returns {activePanel}, containing about or null when closed. Use get_personal_info to read personal information.

tools.name: toggle_experiments
tools.description: Change the visible experiments panel and media feed. Closes it if already open; otherwise opens it and replaces any other panel. Returns {activePanel}, containing experiments or null when closed. Use list_experiments or list_other_experiments to read the content.

tools.name: toggle_project
tools.description: Change the visible project panel. Closes the selected project if already open; otherwise opens it and replaces any other panel. Returns {activePanel}, containing the selected project name or null when closed. Use get_project to read project details.
